whenToUse: Long-form reading such as articles, essays, documentation and reports, where the reader wants to know how far along they are.
Showing minutes left through one article (target) rather than through the whole page.
avoidWhen: Task or upload progress — use progress.
A purely decorative scroll bar with no announced value — use ScrollProgress from motion.
Short pages that fit in one or two screens.
a11y: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow and an aria-valuetext such as "42% · 3 min left"; the floating indicator is aria-hidden because it repeats the bar.
The bar follows the scroll directly, so it stays under reduced motion; only its easing is removed.
